title: AI VTuber Initiative Context
description: Idle-initiative marker for a reply context (issue #87 S1). Serialized form of aivtuber_domain::InitiativeContext: one closed kind saying the performer decided, in deterministic code, to speak on its own because the stream went quiet, so the request's input was not written by a viewer. There is no free text, no viewer text and no history in this contract. It is carried as the optional `initiative` member of the Reflex context and of the Thinking request context; the member is omitted when absent, so a request without one is byte-identical to one built before this contract existed. Authority rule: the context is derived data minted by the runtime's initiative director, never from a payload field, and it grants no capability, permit or gate decision; it cannot reach the operator or control plane.

kind.description: Closed vocabulary of what the performer may start on its own.
